import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the quotes data
quotes_data = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv')

# Filter the data for the last 252 trading days
last_252_days = quotes_data[quotes_data['date'] >= quotes_data['date'].max() - pd.Timedelta(days=252)]

# Pivot the data to have dates as rows and tickers as columns
pivot_data = last_252_days.pivot(index='date', columns='ticker', values='close')

# Calculate the daily returns
returns = pivot_data.pct_change().dropna()

# Calculate the covariance matrix of the returns
cov_matrix = returns.cov()

# Number of assets
num_assets = len(tickers)

# Vector of ones
ones_vector = np.ones(num_assets)

# Inverse of the covariance matrix
inv_cov_matrix = np.linalg.inv(cov_matrix)

# Portfolio variance formula: 1 / (ones_vector.T * inv_cov_matrix * ones_vector)
portfolio_variance_denominator = ones_vector.T @ inv_cov_matrix @ ones_vector

# Minimum variance weights: (inv_cov_matrix * ones_vector) / (ones_vector.T * inv_cov_matrix * ones_vector)
min_variance_weights = (inv_cov_matrix @ ones_vector) / portfolio_variance_denominator

# Normalize the weights to sum to 1
min_variance_weights /= min_variance_weights.sum()

# Create a dictionary of weights
weights_dict = dict(zip(tickers, min_variance_weights))
print(weights_dict)
